starting-off.speaker: Father Reen
starting-off.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for [player name]. I have an urgent job for [him/her].

starting-off.prompt: Start the Shadow of the Storm quest?

steps.player: That's me!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Thank Saradomin I found you!
If the player still has Silverlight:

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: I believe you still have the magical sword Silverlight?

steps.player: The sword I used to defeat the demon Delrith? Yes, I still have it.

steps.text: If the player lost Silverlight:

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Now, do you recognise this sword?
Reen hands you a shining silver sword.

steps.player: Silverlight! That's the sword I used to defeat the demon Delrith!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: There is an urgent task that only you can do - and only with Silverlight!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: My partner Badden and I have been observing the dark wizard Denath, who we believe has been preparing to summon the powerful demon Agrith-Naar.

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: A week ago he took a group of apprentice dark wizards and moved to Uzer, the lost city in the desert. We think he's going to use the city's ancient temple to summon the demon!

steps.player: So you want me to stop him?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Stop him? No! We want you to wait until Agrith-Naar is summoned and then kill him once and for all!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Let me explain. Agrith-Naar is not an ordinary demon. He has immense magical powers, and he can use these powers to influence the mortal plane.

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: This summoning is our chance to rid the world of his evil influence!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: You should go to Uzer and find Badden at once. I'll follow once I've finished some business here.

steps.player: I'll let you know if I see [him/her].

starting-off-talking-to-father-reen-agai.text: If the player still has Silverlight:

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Did you go to Uzer to see Badden?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: You must hurry!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: You idiot! You lost Silverlight! I found it on the sand!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: You need to take it with you and see Badden in Uzer.

to-uzer-talking-to-the-clay-golem.speaker: Clay golem
to-uzer-talking-to-the-clay-golem.text: It is good to see a friendly face here. The priest has said nothing to me but 'Get ye away, foul construct!'

steps.player: Why does Badden hate you?

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: I do not know. I heard him say that Saradomin hates all artificial creatures.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: It was not always so. When I was new, the priests of Saradomin praised the ingenuity of the golem-builders.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: I paraded through the city with my siblings, all painted in bright colours, and they blessed us with holy water as we prepared for battle.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: He should know that I could never hurt him. The first command in a golem's mind is that it cannot allow a human being to come to harm.

options.text: Do you know anything about the dark wizards who arrived here?

steps.player: Do you know anything about the dark wizards who arrived here?

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: Some of them were curious about me when they arrived, but since then they have ignored me.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: As they passed me I felt a sense of dark foreboding, something I have not felt since the great enemy was nearby. I fear they are planning some great evil.

options.text: I want to go through the portal.

steps.player: I want to go through the portal.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Go away! This is OUR portal now!

steps.player: Oh, nothing.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Go away then!

options.text: Where did you get those robes?

steps.player: Where did you get those robes?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah, evil, aren't they? One of the group made them. He said he found some mushrooms in the ruins that could dye things really black.

to-uzer-talking-to-father-badden.speaker: Father Badden
to-uzer-talking-to-father-badden.text: What brings you to this godsforsaken desert?

steps.player: Reen sent me.

steps.text: If the player still has Silverlight:

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Saradomin be praised! And you have Silverlight! You're willing to help us, then?

steps.player: Tell me more about Agrith-Naar.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Agrith-Naar is not so much a demon as a force of nature. While he is in his own dimension his evil magics can reach everywhere in the world.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: No one knows how far his power extends, but Reen and I believe that much of the suffering in the world is due to him.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: The accident that cripples a man, the storm that sweeps a ship under the sea, the sudden fire in the blood that makes a wolf pack attack a town - all that is Agrith- Naar!

steps.player: Tell me more about Denath.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: We've been keeping an eye on Denath for some years now, but we've never been able to move against him.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: He was part of the group that summoned Delrith, but he left Varrock before you arrived and defeated the demon.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: He's been studying Agrith-Naar for years, but when he brought his group here we knew he was about to make his move.

options.text: Why has he come to Uzer?

steps.player: Why has he come to Uzer?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: I'm not sure. This city is very ancient, and its builders were powerful workers of evil magic.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: As that foul construct over there proves.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Perhaps there's something here he needs. Do you know what happened here?

options.text: Foul construct? Do you mean the golem?

steps.player: Foul construct? Do you mean the golem?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: The golem, yes! An abomination in the eyes of holy Saradomin! A mockery of life! Right now Denath is more important, but once he is dealt with I should find some way to destroy it.

steps.player: But the golem was created to fight a demon! You're on the same side!
Thousands of years ago a demon attacked this city, but the golem army drove it off.
When I last came here I opened the portal, and the demon was already dead - it had died of the wounds the golems inflicted.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: You opened a portal to a demon's realm? That must be why Denath is here!

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: It would be much easier to reach Agrith-Naar's realm from another demon's realm than from the mortal plane.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Denath must have heard that the portal here was open and decided to make his move!

options.text: Well I came here and opened a portal to a demon's realm.

steps.player: Well I came here and opened a portal to a demon's realm...

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: You opened a portal to a demon's realm? That must be why Denath is here!

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: It would be much easier to reach Agrith-Naar's realm from another demon's realm than from the mortal plane.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Denath must have heard that the portal here was open and decided to make his move!

options.text: So what do you want me to do?
So what do you want me to do?
So what do you want me to do?

steps.player: So what do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: You have to be in position to kill Agrith-Naar as soon as he is summoned. The best way to do that is to infiltrate the group that is summoning him!

steps.player: How can I do that?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: I don't know. You'll have to find some way to convince them you're one of them.

options.text: I'd never take part in a demonic ritual!

steps.player: I'd never take part in a demonic ritual!

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Oh, don't be so simple-minded! You'll be summoning a demon in order to kill it, to rid the world of great evil! You won't really be joining the group, just infiltrating it.

steps.player: How can I do that?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: I don't know. You'll have to find some way to convince them you're one of them.
If the player lost Silverlight:

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Saradomin be praised!

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: But you will need Silverlight for this task. You should go back and get it.

steps.player: Just passing through.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Oh dear. I was hoping [player name] would arrive.

options.text: I haven't managed to infiltrate the group yet.

steps.player: I haven't managed to infiltrate the group yet.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Oh dear. Do try again. You must be in place when they summon the demon!

options.text: I'd never take part in a demonic ritual!

to-uzer-dyeing-silverlight-black.text: You slice the mushroom with Silverlight, and it stains the blade black.

options.text: I want to go through the portal.
I want to join your group.

steps.player: I want to join your group.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well we do need one more person now, since... um.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But we're an evil group! To join, you have to be evil!
While not wearing enough black items:

steps.player: I'm evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: You don't look evil. You certainly don't dress evil!

steps.player: I'm evil in disguise?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: There's no need for the disguise here! We're all evil!
While wearing 3 black items but Silverlight is undyed:

steps.player: I'm evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: But what's that sword? It's far too shiny to be evil. We won't have any silver glowing swords in here!
While wearing 3 black items and having dyed Silverlight:

steps.player: I'm evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Okay, I'll take you through to see Denath.
Evil Dave escorts you into the demonic throne room.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Master! This person wants to join us!

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for [him/her]?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah! [He/She]'s totally evil!

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Thank you, Dave.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: So you wish to join us? You have made a wise choice. When we summon the demon Agrith-Naar, he will grant all our worldly desires.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: An abyssal whip, a dragon chain mail? To conjure these items is trivial for Agrith-Naar.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: But you will not need such weapons or armour, for Agrith-Naar will grant you the power of life and death over all creatures!

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: You shall have every wish granted, and everyone who has ever wronged you will burn in a hell of your own devising!

steps.player: Isn't this, you know, wrong?

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Right and wrong are for the weak! This is your chance to choose to be on the side of the strong, and have all your desires granted, while the weak are crushed beneath Agrith-Naar's demonic feet!

options.text: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?

steps.player: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!

steps.player: Why did Josef run away?

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Obviously he was a coward who did not have the strength to abandon his old-fashioned morality. I hope you will not be a similar disappointment.

options.text: What do I have to do?

steps.player: What do I have to do?

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: When I have finished preparing the magic circle, we will all recite the incantation that will summon Agrith-Naar.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: You must memorize the incantation carefully. It is Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith-Naar Tarren.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: You will also need to make yourself a demonic sigil to act as a focus of power. One of the group has the mould you need to make it.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Now let me continue with my preparations!

steps.player: Never mind, I'm not evil.

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Well get out of our evil temple then!

options.text: Where did you get those robes?
I managed to get into the group.

steps.player: I managed to get into the group.

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: Oh, that is good! Make sure you are in place when they summon the demon!

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-fath.speaker: Father Reen
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-fath.text: Phew! It's too hot for me out here. But at least I found my way through the desert!

options.text: Why didn't you take the magic carpet?

steps.player: Why didn't you take the magic carpet?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Oh dear no, you won't get me up in one of those things! What if the magic failed?

options.text: Why don't you change out of your heavy robes?

steps.player: Why don't you change out of your heavy robes?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: But the rules of my order say I must wear them!

steps.player: Perhaps the rules were made in a colder place than this?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Saradomin's rules are once and for all! It is not our place to question them!

options.text: Don't worry, soon I'll have killed the demon and we can all go home!

steps.player: Don't worry, soon I'll have killed the demon and we can all go home!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Summoning a demon! Those wizards make me sick! What kind of sad people would call on a supernatural being to solve their problems for them?

steps.player: Um, isn't that like what you do when you pray?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: What? No, that's totally different, because... um... because we always give thanks to Saradomin, even when he doesn't do anything!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Not like those wizards! They're so full of themselves, with their fancy robes and their rituals!

steps.player: Um, isn't that like...

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: No, it's totally different!

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Anyway, there must be something wrong with the way they live in their little group and separate themselves from the rest of society. It can't be healthy.

steps.player: And that's *nothing* like you being a monk, of course.

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: No, nothing like that.

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Wait, are you being sarcastic? Because you should know that sarcasm is specifically forbidden in the holy book of Saradomin!

steps.player: Are you sure Saradomin was being serious about that bit?

steps.speaker: Father Reen
steps.text: Shut up!

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.speaker: Denath
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.text: Leave me alone! I am preparing for the summoning ritual. You should make yourself a demonic sigil and practice the incantation with the other wizards.

options.text: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?

steps.player: I forgot the incantation.

steps.speaker: Denath
steps.text: Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith- Naar Tarren.

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.speaker: Evil Dave
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.text: Welcome, sister! Soon we'll summon the great demon! Aren't we evil?

steps.player: Yeah!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah!
If the gems were removed from the throne:

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: And we've got such an evil throne room to do our ritual in!

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: It's just a pity someone's removed the gems from the throne. That kind of vandalism is TOTALLY NOT EVIL.

steps.player: Um... Yeah, who would do a thing like that?

options.text: But isn't evil, you know, bad?

steps.player: But isn't evil, you know, bad?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: Yeah! We're BAD!

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: No. Last I heard, Matthew had it.

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Evil Dave
steps.text: I didn't see anything. He left last night, and Denath only posted me here this morning.

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: You don't understand.

steps.player: Understand what?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Nobody understands.

steps.player: What don't we understand?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Oh, it doesn't matter. You don't understand. Go away.

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
Do you know what happened to Josef?
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
Do you know what happened to Josef?
Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.text: Without already having it and while having free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Huh. So that's all you want. Here it is.

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Huh.
Without already having it or free inventory space:

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: Come back when you've got free space.
While already having the sigil mould:

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: I already gave that to you! Go away!

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.text: He didn't understand!

steps.player: No, I don't suppose he did.

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.speaker: Patrick
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.text: Agrith-Naar is going to make us all sooo rich!

steps.player: Yeah! We'll all be rich!

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: Yeah! I'm going to get myself a dragon longsword! And a million rune ores! And a small piece of coloured paper to put on my head!

steps.player: Um... if you like.

steps.text: If the gems haven't yet been taken from the throne:

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: Those gems on the demon's throne look valuable. I just wish I had some way to remove them.

options.text: Isn't it more satisfying to earn riches yourself?

steps.player: Isn't it more satisfying to earn riches yourself?

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: I don't want to be satisfied, I want to be rich!

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: Right now I don't have anything. But soon, I will have everything!

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: Denath says he ran away. I don't know why. Who would want to run away from what Agrith-Naar is going to do for us?

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.speaker: Eric
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.text: They won't ignore me for much longer!

steps.player: Who?

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: Everyone!

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: When I have demonic powers, they'll all have to pay attention to me!

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: And SHE won't ignore me then. I'll be able to show her how I feel.

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: I will make everyone like me!

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: No. I gave it to Matthew.

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: He went away and left us. He probably didn't like me.

steps.speaker: Eric
steps.text: Don't ignore me!

infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.speaker: Tanya
infiltrating-the-wizards-talking-to-the-.text: Soon, all will bow down before me!

steps.player: Oh?

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: Agrith-Naar will make us the rulers of the world! I shall be a dark queen over all Gielinor! All shall love me and despair!

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: Ha ha ha ha!

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: Ah ha ha ha ha ha!!

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: AAH HA HA HA HA HA HAAAAA!!!!

steps.speaker: Patrick
steps.text: Look, we've told you not to do that. It makes everyone uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: Sorry.

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: Hah! Carrying such humble implements is beneath me!

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Tanya
steps.text: He was a fool who could not cope with power! When Agrith-Naar makes us rulers of continents, I will find him and crush him!

steps.player: Yes, I suppose I am.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: It just goes to show how little Denath values us.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Denath told us we would learn the secrets of demonic magic, but all we've done is memorize one incantation. And now he replaces poor Josef with the next person who comes along!

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.player: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: No, I think Jennifer has it.

options.text: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.player: Do you know what happened to Josef?

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Shh! Listen, Denath doesn't know this...

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Josef was more curious than me. Last night, he secretly read a book that Denath was keeping from us. He didn't know I was awake, but I saw what happened.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: I saw him read it, and then his face turned white, and he took the book and ran through the portal.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: But Denath was waking up, and when he saw Josef was gone he went through the portal to look for him. A bit later Denath returned, without Josef or the book.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Josef didn't have money for the magic carpet, and he can't have got far in the desert at night with that heavy book.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Josef must have hidden the book somewhere in the ruins, before Denath followed him. If you could find it, we'd know what it was that frightened him. We'd know what Denath is really up to!

options.text: Did you see anything happen here last night?

steps.player: Did you see anything happen last night?

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: I was sleeping last night. I'm only human after all!

steps.speaker: Father Badden
steps.text: But I had this odd dream, about fear and panic, and... fire...

infiltrating-the-wizards-asking-around-a.speaker: Clay golem
infiltrating-the-wizards-asking-around-a.text: It is good to see a friendly face here. The priest has said nothing to me but 'Get ye away, foul construct!'

options.text: Do you know anything about the dark wizards who arrived here?
Did you see anything happen last night?

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: I saw one of the men in dark robes run out of the temple. He looked very frightened and I feared for his safety.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: He was carrying a large book. He started to head out into the desert, but then turned back and hid the book in one of the broken kilns in which my kind were created long ago.

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: Then another man came out of the temple. He said magical words and threw a fireball at the first man, turning him to dust!

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: I should have saved him, but I was not fast enough to throw myself in the path of the fireball.

steps.player: Which kiln did he hide the book in?

steps.speaker: Clay golem
steps.text: I cannot remember. The shock of seeing a human being killed wiped the details of the incident from my memory.
You look in the kiln but you see only sand and fragments of ancient golems.
You find a book in the kiln.

infiltrating-the-wizards-searching-kilns.text: Searching the correct kiln while already having the book:

steps.text: You have already found the book.

infiltrating-the-wizards-returning-to-ma.text: Without the book in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Did you find that book?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: I really want to know what's in it. I think Denath is hiding something from us, but we won't know what unless we read that book!

options.text: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?

infiltrating-the-wizards-returning-to-ma.text: With the book in your inventory:

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Did you find that book?

steps.player: Yes. The golem saw Josef hide it in one of the broken kilns in the city.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Did the golem see what happened to Josef?

steps.player: It said Denath killed him.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: I knew Denath was a dark wizard but I didn't think he'd kill one of his disciples.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: Let me look at the book then.
Matthew quickly reads the book then hands it back to you.

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: I don't understand. What's in here that Denath thought was worth killing over? Josef must have worked something out - but what?

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: But look at the incantation in the book. The words are in the reverse order to the order that Denath taught us.

steps.player: The incantation in the book is backwards?

steps.speaker: Matthew
steps.text: More likely the book has the correct incantation and the one Denath taught us was backwards. But what does that mean?

steps.speaker: Matthew
